Container.Name: jellyfin-poster-manager
Container.Overview:
Jellyfin Poster Manager finds and uploads posters from ThePosterDB to Jellyfin.
The app has no authentication. Do not expose its web interface to the public internet. The container initializes ownership of its data, cache, and logs directories, then runs as PUID:PGID (default 99:100, Unraid's nobody:users). Changing these IDs also changes ownership of existing files in the mapped directories. UMASK controls permissions for new files.

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: The browser-accessible port for the application.

Config.Name: Jellyfin URL
Config.Description: A URL reachable from this container, such as http://192.168.1.10:8096. Do not use localhost for Jellyfin running on the Unraid host.

Config.Name: Jellyfin API key
Config.Description: Create an API key in Jellyfin Dashboard > API Keys.

Config.Name: ThePosterDB email
Config.Description: The email address for the ThePosterDB account used to search for posters.

Config.Name: ThePosterDB password
Config.Description: The password for the ThePosterDB account.

Config.Name: TMDB API key
Config.Description: Optional, but improves title and year matching.

Config.Name: Secret key
Config.Description: A long, randomly generated value used for Flask sessions. Set this before use and retain it across updates.

Config.Name: Application data
Config.Description: Durable SQLite state, jobs, selections, and settings. Ownership is initialized to the configured PUID:PGID at startup.

Config.Name: Cache
Config.Description: Disposable poster-picker cache and temporary images. Ownership is initialized to the configured PUID:PGID at startup.

Config.Name: Logs
Config.Description: Application logs and optional ThePosterDB debug snapshots. Ownership is initialized to the configured PUID:PGID at startup.

Config.Name: ThePosterDB base URL
Config.Description: ThePosterDB endpoint. Normally leave the default unchanged.

Config.Name: ThePosterDB search URL template
Config.Description: ThePosterDB search endpoint; {query} is replaced with the search term. Normally leave the default unchanged.

Config.Name: Web host
Config.Description: Leave at 0.0.0.0 so Unraid's port mapping can reach the application.

Config.Name: Web port
Config.Description: Must match the container port in the Web UI port setting.

Config.Name: Debug mode
Config.Description: Enables detailed application logging and debug routes. Keep disabled during normal use.

Config.Name: Maximum posters per item
Config.Description: Maximum individual poster choices returned for one media item.

Config.Name: Maximum ThePosterDB sets per item
Config.Description: Maximum poster sets returned for one media item.

Config.Name: ThePosterDB batch delay (seconds)
Config.Description: Delay between ThePosterDB batch requests.

Config.Name: Picker cache maximum age (days)
Config.Description: How long disposable picker metadata remains cached.

Config.Name: ThePosterDB debug snapshots
Config.Description: Save ThePosterDB challenge pages to the logs directory. Enable only while troubleshooting.
